// Colab admission for the Firestore backend. Remote composes this fragment under x/colab.
// It admits ciphertext and checks routing facts; it is never authority. Rules cannot hash or
// verify Ed25519, so every client still verifies statements, chains and envelopes.
//
// Tenancy: every document ID is built from the fields it carries (space, page, ...), and every
// condition looks up the admission documents of that same space and page. The text is identical
// for every tenant, so one deploy serves all homes; owner A cannot reach owner B's space.
// IDs join fixed-grammar fields with "_" (no field contains "_", except a trailing uid).
//
// spaces/{space}: first writer owns it (an availability squat, never confidentiality or
//   authority: clients verify the owner chain against the space ID). Never updated or deleted.
// pages/{space_page}: owner admission, finite expiry at most 365 days from refresh.
//   Client policy defaults to 30 days; owner overrides are 1 through 365 days.
//   Deleting it denies every read and write of the page at once.
// links/{space_page_link}: owner-written enrollment secret for a share link, unreadable by holders.
// members/{space_page_uid}: who may read or write. The owner writes rows; a link holder creates
//   its own row by equality with the link's secret (Rules cannot hash a join proof).
// log/{space_page_epoch_stream_seq}: immutable encrypted envelope, contiguous per stream. A stream
//   belongs to the uid that wrote its first entry: seq 1 is safe because a stream ID is unknown until
//   used, and every later entry needs its predecessor's uid to equal the writer's.
// checkpoints/{space_page_epoch_object_index}: immutable encrypted chunk, owned by the
//   uid that wrote index 0 the same way, so no one can fill an object's later chunks with garbage.
//
// A list query is admitted by membership and the page's expiry only: Firestore cannot compare
// a document's own expiresAt with request.time in a query, so a query may return an entry past
// its own expiresAt while the page is still live. A single-document get also checks the
// entry's expiresAt. Clients drop expired entries; rows leave only on owner deletion (no free-plan TTL).
// Entry expiry has its own 365-day ceiling, independent of the page deadline.
// Refreshing the page needs one write; entries refresh only near their own expiry.
// Owners may update only expiry, and delete expired entries or entries
// of an expired/deleted page. Ciphertext and routing facts remain immutable.

match /spaces/{space} {
  allow get: if request.auth != null && resource.data.owner == request.auth.uid;
  allow create: if request.auth != null
    && request.resource.data.keys().hasOnly(['space', 'owner'])
    && request.resource.data.keys().hasAll(['space', 'owner'])

    && ext.get(/spaces/$(resource.data.space)).data.owner == request.auth.uid;

    && ext.get(/pages/$(request.resource.data.space + '_' + request.resource.data.page)).data.state == 'open'
    && ext.get(/pages/$(request.resource.data.space + '_' + request.resource.data.page)).data.epoch == request.resource.data.epoch
    && request.resource.data.expiresAt is timestamp
    && request.resource.data.expiresAt > request.time
    && request.resource.data.expiresAt <= request.time + duration.value(365, 'd')
    && (request.resource.data.seq == 1
      || (ext.getAfter(/authority/$(request.resource.data.space + '_' + request.resource.data.page + '_' + string(request.resource.data.epoch) + '_' + request.resource.data.kind + '_' + request.resource.data.subject + '_1')).data.uid == request.auth.uid
        && ext.getAfter(/authority/$(request.resource.data.space + '_' + request.resource.data.page + '_' + string(request.resource.data.epoch) + '_' + request.resource.data.kind + '_' + request.resource.data.subject + '_1')).data.count == request.resource.data.count
        && ext.getAfter(/authority/$(request.resource.data.space + '_' + request.resource.data.page + '_' + string(request.resource.data.epoch) + '_' + request.resource.data.kind + '_' + request.resource.data.subject + '_1')).data.recipient == request.resource.data.recipient));
  allow delete: if request.auth != null
    && ext.get(/spaces/$(resource.data.space)).data.owner == request.auth.uid
    && (resource.data.expiresAt <= request.time
      || !ext.exists(/pages/$(resource.data.space + '_' + resource.data.page))
      || ext.get(/pages/$(resource.data.space + '_' + resource.data.page)).data.expiresAt <= request.time);
}
